_about: R12 (founder ruling 2026-09-30): the model prices a run-through's cost is computed from (scripts/run_cost.py). The founder updates this file when Azure prices change; nothing else holds a price. USD per 1 million tokens, Azure list prices for our deployment type.
source: https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices?$filter=serviceName eq 'Foundry Models' and armRegionName eq 'westeurope' (Azure Retail Prices API; the meters named below, type Consumption). Pricing page: https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/pricing/details/cognitive-services/openai-service/
deployment_type: GlobalStandard — read from Azure 2026-09-30 (az cognitiveservices account deployment list, valuesims-openai-we): every deployment's sku is GlobalStandard
cached_input: Cached input is billed lower (gpt-4o-2024-11-20: 1.25). The run records do not separate cached tokens, so every input token is priced at the full rate: the computed cost is an upper bound.
